g.inkscape:label: _The Longshade
g.title: forest
g.desc: The old forest that fills the ground between Timbermouth, Ashrun Holt and Longshade Edge. Its edges are worked for timber, charcoal and hides, and the Crossfield Road carries what comes out of it north-east without troubling Port Valen. Its interior is another matter: thick, pathless, and entered by few people who have no business there. Travel: No road crosses it. Going in means overland, at half the pace of a made road.

g.inkscape:label: _The Greymarshes
g.title: coast
g.desc: The seaward edge of the Greymarshes, the low country that carries on past the mapped roads into the rest of the continent. Nothing is settled along it that anyone here trades with. Travel: Nothing crosses it. The coast is the end of the drawn road. Width: 9
